source_revision: Shopify GraphQL Admin API 2026-10 (latest stable per shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning on 2026-11-01; 2025-10 is listed unsupported)
grants: read_all_orders (only for orders older than 60 days)
identity_rule: Account scope = Shop.id (immutable gid, compared on every credential check; a different shop requires a new connection). Record identity = provider gid; provider_event_id = "<shop numeric id>|<object>:<numeric id>|<state or updatedAt>"; entity_refs carry order/customer/transaction/shipment/return/receipt gids.
coverage_rule: Coverage = plan window [requested_from, initial_cutoff) plus the open phase, then continuous from the incremental floor; coverage_to advances only after a complete successful poll. The 60-day default access limit and unreadable nested pages are reported as restrictions, never silently shortened.

retention.basis: Shopify API License and Terms of Use, merchant-owned data, read-only custom app; the merchant owns its order/payout data and installs the app on its own store. Raw provider payloads are stored as sanitized evidence (no customer names/emails/addresses) under the workspace retention policy.

line_id.normalization: Opaque gid per line; lines beyond the first 25 are fetched with BlackboxOrderLineItems follow-up pages.
line_id.missing_behavior: Order without lines yields an order record with an empty lines array.

customer_id.missing_behavior: null for guest checkouts (no fabricated customer).

item_id.missing_behavior: null for custom/non-product lines (no fabricated SKU); stock questions treat the line as unlinked.

quantity.normalization: Decimal string; order.accepted uses quantity (as ordered), order.revised uses currentQuantity (after removals/refunds) and also carries ordered_quantity/unfulfilled_quantity.
quantity.missing_behavior: Required; a line without quantity is rejected.

unit.normalization: Constant unit "piece": Shopify line quantities are integer counts without a unit field.
unit.rule: connectors.normalize.shopify.v1: unit = "piece" for all Shopify quantities.

currency.normalization: ISO 4217 code from the order; all money on the record uses shopMoney in this currency.

line_net_minor.normalization: Integer minor units via exact decimal parsing. order.accepted: originalTotalSet (pre-discount, pre-tax, as ordered); order.revised: discountedTotalSet (after discounts, before taxes). amount_basis is stated on every record.
line_net_minor.missing_behavior: null when the money bag is absent; the order itself is rejected only when originalTotalPriceSet is missing.

line_tax_minor.normalization: Sum of LineItem.taxLines[].priceSet.shopMoney in minor units (revised records); null on order.accepted because taxes are not fixed at acceptance.
line_tax_minor.missing_behavior: null when no tax lines or mixed currencies.
line_tax_minor.rule: connectors.normalize.shopify.v1: sum(taxLines.priceSet) with currency check; inputs = LineItem.taxLines evidence.

line_gross_minor.normalization: line_net_minor + line_tax_minor on order.revised; null on order.accepted.
line_gross_minor.missing_behavior: null when either component is null; never approximated from rounded unit prices.

discount_minor.normalization: LineItem.totalDiscountSet per line and Order.totalDiscountsSet per order on order.revised; null on order.accepted.

shipping_minor.normalization: Order.totalShippingPriceSet in minor units on order.revised; null on order.accepted.

agreed_version.normalization: ISO timestamp of acceptance (createdAt); order.accepted carries original totals, later revisions reference it.

cancellation_state.normalization: "cancelled" when cancelledAt is set (order.cancelled appended with cancelledAt as effective time), otherwise "none".

updated_at.normalization: Order.updatedAt; also the revision suffix of order.revised identities.

event_rules.rule: One per order from Order.createdAt with original (agreed) totals; identity "<shop>|order:<id>|accepted" is stable across re-reads so re-fetches are duplicates. No commitment track is derived until the commitment semantics of an order are confirmed with the engine owner.
One per observed updatedAt > createdAt with current quantities/totals; intermediate edits between polls are not reconstructed.
When cancelledAt is set; effective time = cancelledAt.

synchronization.initial_import: Backfill phase "window": orders with created_at in [requested_from, initial_cutoff) read with BlackboxOrders (sortKey UPDATED_AT, first=10, nested lineItems first=25 with follow-up BlackboxOrderLineItems pages). Phase "open" (when the plan includes open items): orders created before requested_from that are still open/unpaid/unshipped (status:open OR financial_status pending/authorized/partially_paid OR fulfillment_status unshipped/partial). ordersCount(precision EXACT) provides the exact window total; otherwise totals stay unknown. Orders and lines are read through their parent order on every page.
synchronization.cursor: Incremental: query updated_at:>=floor where floor = max(previous floor, min(newest updatedAt seen, now) - 900 s overlap); seeded at initial_cutoff - 900 s when the plan is created (initial_cutoff exactly for strict from-now). Page cursor = Relay endCursor within one phase. Transactions, fulfillments, refunds and returns are versioned by their parent order updatedAt.
synchronization.reconciliation: Every 6 h (and once after sleep/wake with a window bounded to 48 h) re-read updated_at within [to - window, to]; observations are deduplicated by provider_event_id, late revisions append order.revised, nothing is rewritten.
synchronization.deduplication: provider_event_id = "<shop numeric id>|<object>:<numeric id>|<state or revision>" is unique per (tenant, connection); identical content is a duplicate delivery (attempts++), different content under the same identity appends source.conflict_observed and opens a review case. Shop-side refunds and Shopify Payments ledger refunds share economic_effect_id = shopify:transaction:<id>.
synchronization.freshness: Default poll every 300 s (adjustable 60 s to 3600 s, jitter up to 30 s); last_successful_check_at advances only after a complete successful poll, last_new_event_at only when entries were committed; a credential check never advances either. Observed freshness is reported from these timestamps, never promised. Only the current revision of an order is readable; line removals and refunds are distinct (currentQuantity vs refund transactions).

local_standalone.schedule: Incremental poll every 300 s (bounds 60-3600 s, jitter 30 s); reconciliation every 6 h over a 48 h window; backfill paged with checkpoints.
local_standalone.history_limit: Default order access is the last 60 days; older orders require the read_all_orders approval. Only the current version of an order is observable; edits before the first poll are not reconstructed.
local_standalone.authentication: Admin API access token for a merchant-installed custom app (X-Shopify-Access-Token), or the Dev Dashboard client-credentials grant (POST /admin/oauth/access_token, 24h token, refreshed one minute before expiry, no redirect URL). The token is stored encrypted on the connection (AES-256-GCM, key outside the database) and never logged.
local_standalone.recovery: Provider cursor and phase are persisted per page in import_runs.checkpoint / capability_health.*_cursor after COMMIT; a failed page never advances the checkpoint. Expired cursors restart the current phase from its floor (idempotent through the deliveries dedupe boundary). 401/403 stop polling with status reauthorization_required/degraded; 429 waits for Retry-After (fallback 1 s); 5xx retry with exponential backoff (max 5 attempts) then the run is re-queued with backoff; non-retryable failures become visible dead letters. After sleep/wake one coalesced poll per poll group plus one bounded overlap reconciliation (gap + overlap, capped at the reconcile window) is scheduled; no burst replay.
local_standalone.limitations: No webhooks: changes are seen at the next poll. Nested connections beyond the selected page sizes are flagged truncated_connections (lineItems are completed by follow-up pages). Only the current revision of an order is readable; line removals and refunds are distinct (currentQuantity vs refund transactions).
local_standalone.reason: Outbound GraphQL polling needs no inbound route and is supported in local_standalone.

local_gateway.limitations: No gateway runtime exists in the pilot; declared and refused by the connector (LOCAL-07).
local_gateway.reason: local_gateway is deferred scope for the local pilot (delivery-profile.json); no gateway is provisioned and the capability declaration lists no methods for it.

public_server.limitations: No public callback is registered; localhost cannot receive Shopify webhooks.
public_server.reason: public_server is deferred scope for the local pilot; direct webhooks would require a public HTTPS endpoint that the pilot does not provide.

import_readiness.time_selection: Order.createdAt selects the import window (business occurrence); Order.updatedAt selects incremental/reconciliation reads (last modification). Observation time is the poll time; recorded_at is the actual journal commit time and is never backdated.
import_readiness.historical_availability: Default order access covers the last 60 days; older orders need the read_all_orders approval, which is recorded as a restriction on the plan and shown as an accessible-period limit. The current order version is observable, not its intermediate edits: history_kind event_history for new activity, snapshot for the state at first read.
import_readiness.open_and_related_records: With include_open_items the "open" backfill phase retrieves orders created before the window that are still open/unpaid/unshipped; their transactions, fulfillments, refunds and returns come with the order. Traversal is bounded to the order and its nested objects; no unrelated customer history is crawled.
import_readiness.opening_state: No opening balance applies to orders; the first read of an older open order is a snapshot of its current state labeled observation_mode=backfill, never a new sale.
import_readiness.progress_accounting: requested = exact ordersCount of the window (precision EXACT) plus open phase; loaded = orders fetched; committed = distinct logical records with a new journal entry; duplicates/conflicts/rejected are separate; totals_known is true only for backfills with exact counts. Percentages are only shown for the backfill fetch stage.
import_readiness.readiness_rules: Order questions are ready when the connection has a completed backfill for the declared window and the incremental cursor is current within the schedule; partial when the open phase or line-item follow-ups are incomplete (truncated_connections) or the 60-day limit cuts the requested window; blocked without read_orders.
import_readiness.health_rules: healthy after a complete successful poll within interval + jitter; degraded after a failed/partial poll, missing grant or conflicts; unavailable on provider 5xx/429 beyond retries; paused on storage critical. next_check_at is null with a reason (no_import_plan, missing_grant, storage_critical).
import_readiness.history_expansion: A new plan revision creates a history_expansion/backfill run over the additional interval; overlaps are deduplicated by provider_event_id; recorded_at of new entries is the actual import time; prior coverage is preserved.
import_readiness.data_handling: Only opaque gids, amounts, quantities, statuses and timestamps enter payloads; customer is referenced by gid only; evidence stores the sanitized provider object without names, emails or addresses.
